prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1011; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-center lane on a city street in League City, Texas, when Driver 2 attempted to change lanes from the adjacent lane and made contact with the left rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle. The sideswipe left a clear scrape pattern along the body panels on both vehicles, and the damage observed on scene is consistent with the impact as described by both drivers. Two independent witnesses stood near the intersection and told me the collision occurred as Driver 2 merged, and photographs taken at the scene show the same contact points. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and said the force of the impact pushed the body forward and then back against the seat. Driver 1's account of the collision remained consistent throughout our conversation, and Driver 2 did not dispute the sequence of events. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy. Passenger was also in the vehicle and reported no injury at the scene. Our observations found no sign of prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle in the affected areas. Driver 1 was unsure at one point exactly which seat position they occupied during impact, though they were certain they were seated behind the steering wheel.
